cv.headline: Bilingual Customer Service & Technical Support
cv.summary: Bilingual professional with over three years of experience in remote, technology-driven environments, coordinating teams, resolving complex issues, and delivering solutions for clients. Native Spanish speaker with upper-intermediate English (B2+), strong digital fluency, and a proven ability to communicate clearly, learn new platforms quickly, and follow issues through resolution.

experience.title: Technical Lead / Full-Stack Developer
experience.description:
• Coordinated a multidisciplinary remote team, translating client and business requirements into clear priorities and follow-up actions.
• Delivered and maintained production solutions for clients, investigating issues, communicating progress, and following technical problems through resolution.
• Managed simultaneous projects and deadlines while maintaining consistent delivery standards.
• Improved production-system performance by 10x through structured troubleshooting and continuous optimization.

experience.title: Frontend Developer
experience.description:
• Collaborated with external teams to clarify requirements and deliver reliable administrative tools for business users.
• Diagnosed interface and integration issues, shared findings, and coordinated fixes across teams.
• Built clear, user-focused interfaces for enterprise administrative processes.

experience.title: Full-Stack Developer
experience.description:
• Integrated external service providers for credit-evaluation workflows and coordinated technical issue resolution.
• Maintained business-critical applications handling sensitive financial information with accuracy and attention to data privacy.
• Investigated production problems, communicated technical findings, and implemented reliable fixes.

education.degree: Software Programming Technician (Técnico en Programación de Software)
